decisions.reasoning: GBPUSD.x closed at 1.33109 above the prior-12 high 1.33068, a 0.00041 breakout equal to 0.373 ATR. Six-bar and 12-bar changes align at +0.00409 (+3.72 ATR) and +0.00386 (+3.51 ATR). Latest spread 0.00006 is 1.00x the prior-12 median and 0.055 ATR, passing both liquidity limits. The 05:00 pullback held at 1.329225 before a strong 06:00 resumption closed above resistance. Because extension is 0.373 ATR, a BUY_LIMIT at 1.33070 is preferred near the broken boundary; stop 1.32910 sits below the pullback low, and target 1.33360 is inside the prior-12 range-height projection. Entry risk is 0.00160 and reward is 0.00290, estimated 1.81R. EURUSD, AUDUSD and NZDUSD have positive 6/12-bar changes while USDCAD and USDCHF have negative changes, confirming broad USD weakness. AUDUSD and USDCHF also qualify objectively; GBPJPY is rejected as overextended at 0.932 ATR and GBPCAD fails spread at 0.236 ATR. Score 9/10: structure 2, momentum 2, entry 2, spread/liquidity 1, reward/risk 2, cross-market/exposure 0 because account exposure is unverified.
